title: test(cli): pin both halves of Connect-an-Agent visibility over the wire
body:
Fixes #17647

Clause-②: no

Commits the composed measurement #16746's delivering dev took once and deleted because it fell outside that card's declared file surface. This is a transcription of a measurement, not a redesign: the harness, the four readings and the argument for where it lives all come from #16746's `os-dev-report` (`5631274063`) and this card's triage ruling (`5642958095`).

## The four readings, as measured on this branch

All three numbers reproduce the dispatch table exactly — nothing was adjusted to match.

| | principal | route | measured |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **M1** | permissionless | `GET /api/v1/meta/apps/account` | **200**, **12** nav ids, `grp_account_developer` = `nav_account_api_keys` · `nav_account_oauth_apps` · `nav_connect_agent` |
| **M2** | **the same** principal | `GET /api/v1/meta/apps/setup` | **403**, `error.code` = `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `connect_agent` absent from the whole body |
| **M3** | `setup.access` + `manage_platform_settings` | `GET /api/v1/meta/apps/setup` | **200**, **34** ids, `nav_connect_agent` present under `group_integrations` — the lit positive control |
| **M4** | `setup.access` + `manage_platform_settings` | Setup entry count | **34**, byte-for-byte identical to a composition folding only the bundle's `app: 'setup'` half |

Where 34 comes from, so the number is checkable rather than copied: `SETUP_APP` declares 9 nav groups; `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS` fills 7 of them with 25 entries and the MCP bundle adds 1 to `group_integrations`; `group_approvals` receives nothing and the filter collapses the empty group. 9 − 1 + 25 + 1 = 34. Account is 11 authored ids + the 1 contributed = 12.

M1 and M2 are asserted in **one** `it()`, with M3 beside them, because the pairing is the pin: a test asserting only M1 would stay green if someone ungated Setup, and a 403 with no lit control proves the harness ran exactly as much as it proves the gate held.

## What is actually under test

The real `SETUP_APP` / `ACCOUNT_APP` / `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS`, the real `CONNECT_AGENT_UI_BUNDLE`, the real `SchemaRegistry.applyNavContributions` fold and the real `RestServer` RBAC-by-route filter, driven through the registered `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` handler with the stub-the-exec-context pattern from `packages/rest/src/meta-app-publish-gate.test.ts`. `packages/cli` is the only workspace package depending on all four at once — the same argument `packages/cli/scripts/check-app-nav-i18n.mjs` makes in its own header. The fold and the filter are ⛔ not reimplemented anywhere.

Covered for free, per the card: `SETUP_APP.requiredPermissions = ['setup.access']` has no pin of its own today; M2 + M3 cover that the gate is still declared at all.

## Ablation — the pin goes RED on the failure the card names

One leg, committed first, mutation proven on disk and in the built artifact before the colour was read. `packages/cli` resolves `@objectstack/platform-objects` through `exports` to its `dist/`, so each leg is edit → rebuild → preflight → run.

- **MUTATE** — delete `requiredPermissions: ['setup.access']` from the real `SETUP_APP` (i.e. ungate Setup), with `label: 'Setup'` → `label: 'Setup ABLATED17647'` in the same object literal as the dist marker. `ablation-dist-preflight @objectstack/platform-objects ABLATED17647` → *marker present in 4 built files*; the gate literal is gone from `dist/index.js` (1 → 0). Pin run: **1 failed / 1 passed**, `AssertionError: expected 200 to be 403` on the M2 assertion.
- **RESTORE** — `git checkout HEAD -- THE_MUTATED_PATH`, `git hash-object` equal to the HEAD blob `82fdad66e787b0459b43a4814257e6b916c7b0b2`, whole-tree `git status --porcelain` empty, rebuild, `--absent` preflight *marker absent from all 66 built files*, gate literal back to 1. Pin run: **2 passed**.

⚠️ Observed direction reported as observed, not as predicted: M4 stayed **green** under the ungating. That is correct — M4 measures the admin tree's invariance against the account-side half, which dropping the app-level gate does not move. The leg that reddens M4 would be a mutation of the bundle's contribution targets.

The two edits and both legs are throwaway; nothing from the ablation is in this diff.

## Verification

Union run against the final commit `524a9fe04`.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the final 3-path diff → 48 families. Each run with output redirected to its own log and `$?` captured **before** any pipe, recorded as `command :: exit N`, then reconciled: *"Run reconciliation — 48 derived, 48 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN"* with *"EXIT CODES — all 48 accounted families carry one"*. **All 48 exit 0.**
- Two the tool does not name and this lane adds: `pnpm lint` repo-wide to completion (`eslint . --no-inline-config`, 94s on a shared box, **exit 0**) — so no narrowing is claimed and none of the three narrowing evidences is owed; and `node packages/cli/scripts/check-app-nav-i18n.mjs` **exit 0**, hit line *"OK (10 contributor(s), 54 merged `setup` nav id(s), 4 locale(s), every id labelled in every locale)"*, plus its `--self-test` exit 0.
- Receiving package on the merged tree, one lock hold, `VERDICT command-exit 0`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (*"check:test-typecheck: OK — 3 file(s) / 28 error(s)"*, the pre-existing ledgered population, **zero in the new file**) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit` → **199 files / 2831 tests passed**.
- Typecheck coverage proven rather than assumed: `tsc --noEmit --listFiles -p tsconfig.test.json` counts the new file **1** of 2275 program files.
- `integration` tier declared to CI: this diff touches no integration-tier file, no spawn entry and no driver/kernel boot path.
- `origin/main` merged per Multi-agent discipline §9/§10 (`packages/rest/src/index.ts` moved on the incoming side and this package's test program now reads rest's source); clean merge, **no os-regen deferral recorded**, install + closure rebuild + the whole verification above re-run on the merge result.

## Two consequences of the new file, both the gates' own prescriptions

1. `packages/cli/vitest.config.ts` — this is the first `new SchemaRegistry(` in `packages/cli` (measured: 0 occurrences at the base tree), so `check-registry-log-declared` now selects this package. A root-level `env` is inert under `projects`, so `env: { OS_REGISTRY_LOG: 'warn' }` is declared inside **each** project's own test block, verbatim as the gate prints it.
2. `packages/cli/tsconfig.test.json` — `check:type-source-resolution` flagged `@objectstack/rest` as a NEW dist-resolved type import for this package. Takes the gate's prescribed route, a star-less `paths` rule for a dep exposed through an **existing** program, rather than widening its shrink-only registry; `rootDir` already spans the repo root and rest publishes only `"."`. Both gates are green above.

## Changeset — deliberately skipped, with the reading

Nothing published moves. `@objectstack/cli`'s `files[]` is `["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]` and `tsconfig.build.json` declares `include: ["src"]`, so `test/` is not compiled and not shipped. Built-output grep over the 508 files of `packages/cli/dist`:

- negative — `connect-agent-both-halves-wire`, `grp_account_developer`, `composedRegistry`, `BOTH-HALVES`: **0 files each**;
- positive control — `artifactPackagesOf` **2**, `nav-contribution-groups` **6**, `findNavGroupDiagnostics` **4**.

So the zero is a reading, not an empty grep. `skip-changeset` applies.

## Serial constraints

#17528 is in flight in this lane; its file set (fetched and diffed, not assumed) is `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts`, `test/fixtures/option-b-collection-zoo.ts`, `test/fixtures/option-b-reader-probe.ts`, `test/lint-handwritten-checks-package-fold.test.ts`, `test/option-b-reader-acceptance.pin.test.ts` and its changeset — **disjoint** from all three paths here, `packages/cli/vitest.config.ts` and `packages/cli/tsconfig.test.json` included.
